about: THE GTK ROWS (B-4260, lane ci-aidev-desktop-batch 2026-10-14): what each box's desktop stack draws the pixel suites' GNOME Calculator as, MEASURED by scripts/ci-provision-aidev.sh's gtk-row step INSIDE a private xpra server, as the suites run it (no client attached): calcSize2x = the window's size at GDK_SCALE=2; calcMinFirst2x / calcMin2x = its WM_NORMAL_HINTS minimum when first announced / once it holds 2 s; calcButtonBound = the 1× minimum is unchanged under Xft.dpi 144 (calcMin1x vs calcMin1xDpi144); pushButtonRole = the role AT-SPI names a push button. Keyed by the GTK 4 major.minor; scripts/scratch.mjs gtkRow() hands the running box's row to the suites (test-desktop-xpra-window, test-window-target, test-app-display-a11y-bus-tree) and THROWS for a GTK with no row — never a skip. ci-remote.mjs --batch refuses a box whose measured row is not this file's. controlRatio15: test-desktop-xpra-window §15 CONTROL's measured column ratio on that box (the pre-lane-D rule halves a button-bound calculator: 0.5).
